messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're rolling an audit event schema update that adds RBAC privileged_action types + richer KMS rotation events. Need quick review on customer comms and the validation kit before tomorrow's sync.
aj: Can you paste the new enum values? I want to make sure nothing collides with existing SIEM mappings.
maria: privileged_action: ["ASSUME_ROLE", "PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION", "SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN_ISSUE"]
  Also adding kms_event.type = "KEY_ROTATION" with fields: key_id, rotated_by, rotation_reason (optional).
sam: Are we keeping v4 payloads stable? Customers will be ingesting these into log pipelines.
maria: Backcompat: v5 adds fields but all old fields remain. We will emit header: audit_schema_version = "v5" in the envelope. For pipelines that only expect v4, we will include a compatibility shim for 60 days.
kevin: Suggest we include a short example for SIEM mapping in the comms, like:
```
{
  "envelope": { "audit_schema_version": "v5" },
  "event": {
    "action": "ASSUME_ROLE",
    "actor": { "id": "svc-123", "type": "service_account" },
    "resource": { "type": "project", "id": "proj-56" },
    "kms_event": {"type":"KEY_ROTATION","key_id":"key-99","rotated_by":"maria","rotation_reason":"policy_expiry"}
  }
}
```
maria: Nice. I'll add that to the sample pack. Audit-bot: new sample pack uploaded -> s3://redwood-audit/samples/v5/pack-2026-03-20.zip :eyes:
aj: For enterprise customers with on-prem/private, do we need any special KMS guidance? e.g., HSM exportability notes?
maria: Yes — docs page will include: 1) for HSM-backed keys, we emit only key_id and rotation metadata; 2) if customer-managed keys are in use, they should ensure rotate hooks are allowed to post events to our control-plane endpoint. Will include config snippet and required network egress.
sam: Communication staging plan? Draft to customers, beta group, then general announce?
emia (typo: maria corrects): maria: Plan: 1) Private/Dedicated customers with KMS or RBAC integrations get targeted email + sample bundle (3 days before rollout). 2) Public hosted customers get announcement + migration guide (day of rollout). 3) Beta customers get opt-in to early v5 testing this week.
kevin: Add a short validation checklist for customers:
- Confirm ingestion accepts audit_schema_version header
- Map privileged_action enum to internal rules
- Validate KMS rotation events produce alerts if rotated_by is unexpected
- Run sample pack through pipeline and confirm no parser errors
maria: I'm preparing a small validation kit repo with a test harness and curl examples:
```
# run sample through endpoint
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @sample.json https://ingest.redwood.ai/audit?schema=v5
```
audit-bot: smoke test results: 12/12 sample payloads parsed on staging (timestamp 2412359200)
aj: OK — who owns the customer-facing changelog blurb? I can draft then pass to comms.
maria: I'll draft the technical appendix + sample payloads. AJ you can own the plain-language customer note. Kevin can review SIEM mapping snippet.
kevin: Will do. Also propose we add a short rollback play: if major parsing errors observed, we toggle envelope header to force v4 shim (automated rollback window 24h).
maria: Good call. I'll add to the runbook and call out the rollback command. Sample: `./tools/enable-compat-shim --version v4`
sam: Anything else for vulnerability triage or incident response? If a rotation event looks suspicious we should surface to sec-oncall as high.
maria: We'll add event tagging: kms_event.type=KEY_ROTATION + actor.type != "system" => escalate. I'll file a small alerting runbook in incidents.
aj: Great. I'll push a PR with the customer note by EOD.
maria: Thanks all — please review the sample pack link and validation kit in the PR once up. We'll sync in tomorrow's stand to confirm timelines. :thumbsup:
